purpose: Preserve and study every observed keirin track circumference as its own exact-length research lane instead of limiting storage to previously supported frozen-model buckets.
owner_directive: All existing race track lengths may be stored and handled separately by length.

storage_policy.lane_key_rule: Use the exact authoritative track circumference value as the research-lane key; lengths that differ remain separate lanes.
storage_policy.future_or_new_lengths: Automatically create a new exact-length lane when an authoritative source exposes a circumference not previously present.

research_policy.unsupported_by_current_frozen_adjustment: Still capture PRE data and outcomes in its exact-length lane. Do not mislabel as a supported length. Build and validate a length-specific challenger when enough evidence exists.
research_policy.baseline_models_without_length_adjustmen: May be evaluated separately where their frozen contract does not require a supported circumference bucket; this does not authorize pretending the current 333/400 circumference challenger supports another length.

supersession_note: Any prior workflow wording that treated 335m, 500m, or any other non-333/400 circumference as storage-excluded is superseded. Such races are now retained in their own exact-length research lanes.
